correctness.rationale: For each of the 16 switched K5 pentagonal facets, a_W.x<=6-q with min=-q; independent exact rational Walsh check found sum_W q=80, sum_W a_W=0 and A^T A=16I_10. Reflection constraints sum to 0<=16(s-5), so s>=5; equality forces all K5 coordinates half. Facet classification of edge-maximal K3,3-minor-free H (Chimani et al Thm3.3) has only switched triangle/pentagon constraints; half vector realizes factor5 (triangles have factor3), and every optimum center obeys exactly the written triangle halfspaces plus K5 pinning. Strict triangle slack at the half vector is 1/6, establishing affine dimension equal to number of non-K5 edges. For nonmaximal G, coordinate projection from an edge-maximal supergraph and onto K5 copies proves the claimed s=5 and center pinning, without claiming full center dimension for nonmaximal G.
residual_risks: Computational corroboration is restricted to the stated finite class; it is not a general numerical experiment proof.
